_doc: Component-stress suite, fixed 2026-07-29. Replaces the full 25-game run as the iterate loop: a full --real pass costs ~2h (ar25 alone is 710s) and 23/25 games score 0, so most of that time buys no signal. Each game below is here because it is the HARDEST case for a named component -- not because the agent happens to do well on it. DEV games only; the 8 held-out games are never run while tuning. Selection is by component stress, so a fix that only helps one of these games still has to survive the others plus the held-out split.

0_units.gate: self-tests pass, test_eyes 31/31, test_griddsl 204/204 (17871 sweep combos), test_synth 101/101, test_livelock 108/108, reachgoal 3/3 (69 acts), keydoor 2/2 (93 acts)
0_units._gate_history: reachgoal was 78 acts until the 2026-07-29 GridDSL work (data-derived displacement + step_color stride); 69 is the new floor, do not relax it back.  2026-07-30: the world-model work (masked verify + premise check + judge) measures reachgoal 3/3 at 70 acts and keydoor 2/2 at 92 acts. Toys still SOLVE, but reachgoal is +1 over the 69 floor. NOT relaxing the floor to 70: it is one action on a toy, cause not yet isolated (suspected the widened _candidate_ops changing an early tie-break). Investigate before the next floor edit.  2026-07-30 (livelock breaker): reachgoal 3/3 at 70 acts, keydoor 2/2 at 91 acts. The reachgoal 70 was CONFIRMED PRE-EXISTING -- a control run with ARC_NO_BREAKER=1 also measures 70, so the +1 belongs to the earlier world-model work, not the breaker; the breaker improved keydoor 92->91. Floor still NOT relaxed. Seeds 1/2/3 give reachgoal 81/90/99 and keydoor 119/112/174, so seed 0's 69-70 is the lucky tail, not a hard bound -- the real gate is that both toys SOLVE at every seed.  2026-08-03 (A1 death control + C1 object basis + the buckets() relative-ranking fix): reachgoal 3/3 at 78 acts, keydoor 2/2 at 93 acts. The reachgoal 70->78 drift is CONFIRMED PRE-EXISTING and NOT from this session's work -- a control run with ARC_NO_DEATH=1 ARC_NO_OBJFEAT=1 ARC_NO_O3=1 measures 78 identically, and reachgoal routes through ReactivePlanner which never touches ProgressModel. 78 is exactly the pre-GridDSL number, so suspect the stride/step_color path regressed between 07-30 and now (the reachgoal log shows the world model PROMOTE stride-8, DEMOTE it at acc=0.35, then re-PROMOTE stride-6 -- one wasted promotion cycle). Floor still NOT relaxed; both toys still SOLVE, which is the real gate. INVESTIGATE: bisect the stride fit between the 07-30 state and now.

1_core.when: after every change with pipeline blast radius, ~4 min
1_core.why: the four CHEAP representatives, one per game family: pure-click (lp85 = standing gate, 37s), click with brutally short human budgets (r11l, 18s), movement/mechanical (ls20, 150s), odd action set 5/6/7 (sb26, 43s). Rebalanced 2026-07-29 after measuring: tr87 741s, wa30 877s, sc25 663s and tu93 638s are too slow for a per-change loop, and all four score 0 or unchanged, so they buy nothing at this cadence.
1_core.gate: no game's `honest` may fall below the baseline below. Levels-completed is NOT the gate: it is a coarse integer that cannot see a level won in half the actions, which is exactly what RHAE pays for. Read `honest` (capability, each level counted once), never `official` (which credits churn) -- both come from eval/official_score.py, the single scoring source.

honest_baseline._as_of: 2026-08-02, seed 0, cap 1500, re-confirmed unchanged after the O1 proof/budget split, the O1 button-identity fix, and O3 (ProgressModel) frontier ordering

1_core._honest_history: 2026-08-01: lp85 0.0988 -> 0.3352 (3.4x) when ClickPlanner started expanding its own graph in imagination instead of replaying from the root for every probe (click.search 72% -> 12% of budget, 0 wipes, still 1/8 levels). LEVEL COUNTS DID NOT MOVE AT ALL for this change -- the entire gain is invisible to a levels-based gate, which is why the gate is now `honest`. || 2026-08-02: O1 (proof-vs-budget split + Chebyshev button identity) and O3 (ProgressModel orders the click frontier by progress before cost) land at EXACTLY the baseline -- lp85 0.3352 / r11l 0 / ls20 0 / sb26 0, overall 0.0838, 0 wipes, inflation 1.0x. Correct and expected, not a disappointment: lp85's only win is level 1 at action 95, reached identically in every build, and all three changes act on the part of the run that has never succeeded. Neither has yet EARNED its place on score; both are kept because they are strictly more truthful (a resource limit is no longer filed as a refutation) and reversible (ARC_NO_O3=1). The O3 prior (ARC_O3_PRIOR=1) is written but UNMEASURED and off.
1_core._timing_history: 2026-07-30: profiling ls20 (cProfile, 300 actions) charged 122.0s of 137.2s to EnumerativeSynthesizer.synthesize -- detect_background recomputed per CANDIDATE inside _fits (66.2s), json.dumps of every candidate against an empty `banned` set (12.8s), and the 200-deep transition buffer rescanned for `changed`/palette every action. Memoising Transition.changed/.palette and hoisting bg out of the candidate loop cut ls20 475.3s -> 219.0s and lp85 34.1 -> 19.7s with bit-identical behaviour (toys still 69/93 actions, all tier-1 level counts unchanged). ls20 was 150s before the 2026-07-29 GridDSL work; ARC_NO_STRIDE=1 measured 409.7s vs 465.2s, so the data-derived displacement candidates account for ~12% of the remaining gap and the richer per-colour op set for the rest.

2_full.when: before declaring a component done, ~55 min
2_full.why: tier 1 plus the five expensive stressors: tr87 (world model), tu93 (hidden state -- and the current best score, 2/9), sc25 (routing), bp35 (perception), wa30 (long-horizon pathing)

3_heldout.when: rarely -- generalization report only, never inspected while tuning

1_eyes_StateEncoder.evidence: measured on a 643-frame real corpus: the outer chrome/HUD margin wins the border vote, so the play-field floor comes back as ONE phantom object. bp35 bg_cov=0.46 largest_obj=1529px AND n_objs=191 (worst in both directions); lp85 bg_cov=0.39 largest=1962px (48% of the grid); tr87 bg_cov=0.38 largest=1352px.
1_eyes_StateEncoder.stresses: detect_background / play-area isolation, flood_fill_objects, object count sanity

2_world_model_GridDSL_synth.evidence: tr87 is the purest target: 4 actions, no clicks, human 37/30/39/29/63/119 -- if a learned transition model works anywhere it works here. tu93 has history-dependent HIDDEN state (recorded), so it is the case that falsifies a purely visible-state model.
2_world_model_GridDSL_synth.stresses: op exactness, synthesis only trusting verified programs, latent-state representability

3_memory_StateGraph.evidence: HUD periodicity masks were validated on tu93/tr87 (row 63) and ls20 (rows 61-62); tu93's hidden state makes visible-graph exhaustion illusory, which is exactly what nearest_untested must not be fooled by.
3_memory_StateGraph.stresses: exact edges, HUD masking, BFS-to-nearest-untested, DeadActionTracker

movement.evidence: wa30 is 5-action keyboard, 9 levels, human 125/58/259/113/499 -- the longest-horizon pathing in the set; ls20 is the mechanical movement case where BFS-on-lattice provably does not transfer.

click.evidence: lp85 is the standing gate (1/8). r11l has the tightest human budgets in the whole set (7/28/30/20/37/45) -- under RHAE's square, a coverage sweep is instantly fatal there, so it is the sharpest test of plan-unscored discipline. Both are cheap (7s / 18s).

5_orchestrator_choose_action.evidence: sc25 offers actions 1,2,3,4,6 with tiny baselines (39/5/32/33) -- routing must pick the right planner family fast. sb26's action set is 5,6,7 (no directional keys at all), so it breaks any router that assumes keyboard=movement.
5_orchestrator_choose_action.stresses: the routing ladder; NO game-specific branches allowed

measured_2026_07_30_world_model._doc: Two full 11-game runs, seed 0, PYTHONHASHSEED=0, max-actions 1500. state_A = masked verify + evidence() premise check; state_B = A + WorldModelManager.judge (the ONLINE accuracy tracker, which had been comparing raw). EVERY level score in both states equals baseline_2026_07_29_seed0 -- the world-model work is score-neutral so far. What it buys: synthesize went from returning None on all 16 dev games to promoting verified models on 6 of these 11, demotions fell 57 -> 4 (-93%), and suite-9 wall clock fell 3459s -> 2807s (0.81x). WARNING: state_B tu93's 12996.8s is an artifact -- Windows Modern Standby suspended the process for 12206s (Kernel-Power 506 at 16:01:14, 507 at 19:24:40). Real time ~790s; the log profile is identical to state A (3 promotions, 0 demotions, 2 level-ups, 2/9).

refuted_do_not_rebuild.B2_hud_progress_meter: lp85's 10 never-revisiting candidate cells (rows 43-46, cols 24-27) are constant for frames 0-90 of the 95-frame win and change only at frames 91/93/94 -- the level-up animation. Backtests perfectly, guides nothing. r11l/sb26 have zero candidates.
refuted_do_not_rebuild.A1_as_avoidance_direction: across 19 distinct r11l deaths only 1 of 20 colour features and 0 of 10 object features share a direction. Deaths agree about almost nothing, so -death cannot serve as a progress direction on the 23 never-winning games.
